database.name: HefnoPlant Active Ingredients Database
database.description: Scientific database of agricultural herbicide active ingredients (weed-control chemistry), classified by HRAC mode-of-action groups, with target weed and crop relationships. Compiled from HRAC group data, active ingredient profiles, and herbicide-weed efficacy relationship tables. Active-ingredient-first: no commercial/trade product names, brands, or prices are included.
database.scope: Herbicide (weed-control) active ingredients only — sourced files did not cover insecticide, fungicide, or other pesticide categories.
